title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll dealt the Qanun direction: the homepage set like a working page of Ibn Sino's Canon. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Qanun, as a working page
options.lineage: Rubricated manuscripts and scholarly editions of Ibn Sino's al-Qanun fi't-tibb
options.thesis: The center's offer is set like a page of the Canon: rubric red marks every heading, number and action, and the courses are its table.
options.viewport: A vermilion headpiece band carries the title; below it all six courses sit in one ruled table, and the application form is the table's last line.
options.risk: Becomes museum costume the moment rubrication turns into ornament; no gold, no arabesque borders, no faux parchment.

raised.raise: Density courage: every course with its requirement, duration and price in one ruled table, no card inflation.
State is a mark, not a hue: open, chosen and sent are marginal rubric marks on the row.
Numbered exits: every destination is a numbered rubric line, reachable by keyboard.
Signals drawn on the surface: choosing a course draws its mark onto the page and fills the form in place, never a modal.

options.label: Herbarium sheet
options.thesis: Each course, service and product is mounted like a specimen with a typed, stamped label: science you can hold.
options.viewport: One large mounted sheet: the headline is the specimen label, with the course list as the herbarium's accession register beside it.
options.risk: Botany leans toward the wellness look you ruled out, and it is where many runs in this category land.

options.label: Swiss poster grid
options.thesis: Each course is a poster in one series on one master grid.
options.viewport: Six course posters tile the grid; the chosen one takes the red and opens the form.
options.case: Holds product clarity; loses audience identification, since nothing in it reads as Uzbek or as tabobat.

options.label: Courtyard dye canopy
options.lineage: Indigo, madder and saffron silk over a sunlit courtyard
options.thesis: Madder and saffron are both dyes and medicines: the four kitob of the center cross as dyed silk lanes.
options.viewport: Four translucent lanes cross the first screen; where the Ta'lim lane overlaps, the application opens.
options.case: Holds audience identification with Uzbek dye and courtyard culture; loses on clarity, since the offer reads late.
options.risk: Abstract color play can bury the courses and prices.

options.label: High-density modules
options.thesis: Everything the center offers, packed into ruled modules on one screen.
options.viewport: A mosaic of course, service and product modules.
options.case: Loses both axes: foreign to the audience and noisier than the offer needs.
options.kept: Density courage: all course facts in one ruled table.

options.label: Cutting-bench rail
options.thesis: Courses strung as frames along a perforated rail.
options.viewport: A rail of course frames across black.
options.case: Loses both axes: no tie to the audience or to medicine.
options.kept: State is a mark, not a hue.

options.label: ANSI bulletin board
options.thesis: The center as a numbered text-mode menu.
options.viewport: An ANSI title screen over numbered menu lines.
options.case: Loses both axes: novelty that undercuts an official institution.

options.label: Chromatophore skin
options.thesis: A living surface whose pattern shifts with what the visitor chooses.
options.viewport: A rippling skin with signals drawn across it.
options.case: Loses both axes: biology spectacle with no link to the center.
options.risk: Heavy GPU work for little meaning.
options.kept: Signals drawn directly on the surface.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean education-center site, executed with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and Apply button over a class photo, then a row of course cards, stats and reviews.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other training center, and it needs photos and reviews you don't have yet.
